question: Which mantra elements are placed at the beginning of the sequence, O beloved?
premises: Kālī, Kāmakalā, and Kūrca are named.
These are placed at the beginning of all.
inference: The sequence begins with Kālī, Kāmakalā, Kūrca, and the praṇava.
uncertainties: The exact syllabic values of these names are not spelled out in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, Kālī, Kāmakalā, Kūrca, and the praṇava come at the beginning of all.
